research_decision.current_strongest_research_conclusion: This run validates whether artificial propagation sensitivity explains real quantizer degradation better than raw reconstruction error. It is evidence gathering, not method design.
research_decision.recommended_next_step: Repeat with a denser head grid or longer paths before designing adaptive precision.
